senses.gloss:
प्रफर्वी Ved. A woman having excellent hips or going in a graceful
 way; a lewd girl (?).

प्रफुल्त p. p. Blooming, blossomed, full-blown; लोध्रद्रुमं
 सानुमतः प्रफुल्तम् R. 2. 29 (v. l. for प्रफुल्ल). cf. P. VII. 4. 89 com.

प्रफुल्ल p. p.
—1 Full-blown, blossoming, blooming; न हि प्रफुल्लं सहकारमेत्य वृक्षान्तरं
 काङ्क्षति षट्पदाली R. 6. 69, 2. 29; Ku. 3. 45, 7. 11.
—2 Expanded or dilated like a full-blown flower (as eyes).
—3 Smiling.
—4 Shining.
—5 Gay, cheerful, pleased.

प्रफुल्ल + -नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन a. with eyes expanded with joy.
प्रफुल्ल + -नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन a. with eyes expanded with joy.
प्रफुल्ल + -नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन a. with eyes expanded with joy.
प्रफुल्ल + -वदन a. having a beaming or cheerful countenance, looking cheerful.
